scenarios.name: Prepare for a meeting
scenarios.summary: Build a cited brief from approved files, messages, and calendar context.
scenarios.output: A one-page meeting brief with sources and open questions.

scenarios.name: Create a weekly report
scenarios.summary: Turn dated project and business updates into a reviewable status report.
scenarios.output: A status report with outcomes, blockers, metrics, and owners.

scenarios.name: Draft an email
scenarios.summary: Prepare a contextual email draft while keeping sending under human control.
scenarios.output: An unsent draft marked for fact and recipient review.

scenarios.name: Turn a report into slides
scenarios.summary: Create a presentation outline grounded in a source report and its evidence.
scenarios.output: A slide outline with source pages, caveats, and visual suggestions.

resources.name: Productivity plugin
resources.summary: Track tasks, maintain workplace context, and create a local work dashboard for recurring knowledge work.
resources.compatibilityEvidence: Anthropic describes the plugin as primarily designed for Cowork and also compatible with Claude Code.
risks: Review task and memory file changes before sharing
resources.safeTest: Create one test task in a temporary workspace and inspect the changed files.

resources.name: Operations plugin
resources.summary: Prepare vendor reviews, process documentation, change requests, and capacity plans from approved business inputs.
resources.compatibilityEvidence: The Anthropic source repository identifies this as a Cowork-first knowledge-work plugin.
permissions: Optional project or ITSM connector data
risks: Draft process and compliance outputs require owner review
resources.safeTest: Generate a process outline from a synthetic three-step workflow.

resources.name: Data analyst plugin
resources.summary: Explore datasets, draft SQL, build visualizations, and document analytical assumptions.
resources.compatibilityEvidence: Anthropic describes the data plugin as primarily designed for Cowork with Claude Code support.
risks: Queries and conclusions require validation against source data
resources.safeTest: Summarize a synthetic CSV and recompute one result manually.

resources.name: Marketing plugin
resources.summary: Develop positioning, campaign plans, content, and performance reviews from supplied market evidence.
resources.compatibilityEvidence: This plugin is published in Anthropic's Cowork-focused knowledge-work repository.
risks: Public claims and campaign actions require approval
resources.safeTest: Create a positioning table from two synthetic customer interviews.

resources.name: Sales plugin
resources.summary: Prepare account research, call plans, follow-ups, and pipeline reviews using approved CRM context.
resources.compatibilityEvidence: This plugin is published in Anthropic's Cowork-focused knowledge-work repository.
risks: Customer-facing claims and messages require review
resources.safeTest: Create a call plan from a fictional account brief without sending messages.

resources.name: Finance plugin
resources.summary: Support financial analysis, close reviews, forecasting, and management reporting from approved data.
resources.compatibilityEvidence: This plugin is published in Anthropic's Cowork-focused knowledge-work repository.
risks: Financial outputs require reconciliation and accountable approval
resources.safeTest: Analyze a synthetic budget variance and verify every subtotal.

resources.name: Legal plugin
resources.summary: Organize contract review, policy research, and legal operations material for qualified human review.
resources.compatibilityEvidence: This plugin is published in Anthropic's Cowork-focused knowledge-work repository.
risks: Not a substitute for qualified legal advice
Confidential material needs controlled access
resources.safeTest: Extract defined terms from a synthetic agreement and compare them with the source.

resources.name: Human resources plugin
resources.summary: Prepare recruiting, onboarding, policy, performance, and workforce-analysis materials.
resources.compatibilityEvidence: Anthropic publishes this plugin for Cowork-oriented people operations.
risks: Employment decisions and sensitive personal data require strict human controls
resources.safeTest: Generate an onboarding checklist for a fictional employee.

resources.name: Customer support plugin
resources.summary: Prepare support summaries, response drafts, knowledge articles, and quality reviews from approved cases.
resources.compatibilityEvidence: This plugin is published in Anthropic's Cowork-focused knowledge-work repository.
risks: Customer replies and account changes require approval
resources.safeTest: Draft a response to a fictional ticket without sending it.

resources.name: Product management plugin
resources.summary: Structure discovery, requirements, roadmaps, and product reviews from approved research and project context.
resources.compatibilityEvidence: This plugin is published in Anthropic's Cowork-focused knowledge-work repository.
risks: Priorities and commitments require product-owner approval
resources.safeTest: Turn three synthetic interview notes into a problem list with citations.

resources.name: Design plugin
resources.summary: Create design briefs, critique interfaces, and organize brand and user-experience work from supplied context.
resources.compatibilityEvidence: Anthropic publishes this plugin in its Cowork-oriented knowledge-work collection.
risks: Generated assets need brand, copyright, and accessibility review
resources.safeTest: Critique a synthetic wireframe against a three-item design brief.

resources.name: GitHub plugin
resources.summary: Work with repositories, issues, pull requests, and code review through GitHub's official integration.
resources.compatibilityEvidence: Claude Marketplace lists the official GitHub MCP server and describes use with Claude tools.
permissions: Repository permissions granted to the connected GitHub identity
risks: Writes can change issues, branches, and pull requests
resources.safeTest: Read one public repository issue without creating or changing anything.

resources.name: Slack plugin
resources.summary: Search approved Slack conversations and prepare messages using the connected user's channel access.
resources.compatibilityEvidence: Claude Marketplace lists Slack as an Anthropic-verified integration and describes Cowork collaboration workflows.
permissions: Channels and messages visible to the connected Slack user
risks: Posting messages affects other people and requires review
resources.safeTest: Find one known message in a named channel without posting.

resources.name: Frontend design skill
resources.summary: Guide Claude Code toward distinctive, production-oriented interface design and implementation.
resources.compatibilityEvidence: The skill is distributed through Anthropic's official Claude Code plugin directory; Cowork compatibility is not claimed here.
permissions: Project files granted to Claude Code
risks: Generated code can change project behavior and must be reviewed
resources.safeTest: Use the skill on a disposable static component and inspect the diff.

resources.name: Playwright plugin
resources.summary: Automate browser checks and end-to-end testing in a controlled development project.
resources.compatibilityEvidence: Claude Marketplace lists a Playwright integration for browser automation; this entry limits compatibility to Claude Code until Cowork use is separately verified.
permissions: Browser session and test project files
risks: Automation can submit forms or alter test environments
resources.safeTest: Open a local test page and read its heading without submitting forms.

resources.name: Google Workspace connector
resources.summary: Connect Gmail, Calendar, and Drive for approved search, drafting, scheduling, and file workflows.
resources.compatibilityEvidence: Anthropic documents Google Workspace connectors for Claude and Cowork workflows.
permissions: Google resources visible to the connected account
Separate approval for supported write actions
risks: Wrong-account access and external sends require careful review
resources.safeTest: Find one known Drive file by exact title without changing it.

resources.name: Microsoft 365 connector
resources.summary: Connect Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint, Calendar, and Teams through the intended Microsoft identity.
resources.compatibilityEvidence: Anthropic documents Microsoft 365 use in chat and Cowork, with separate personal and managed-account setup paths.
permissions: Microsoft resources visible to the connected identity
risks: Write actions can send messages, change calendars, and update files
resources.safeTest: Find one known OneDrive file by exact title without changing it.

resources.name: Firecrawl MCP
resources.summary: Retrieve public web pages for research workflows through Firecrawl's MCP server.
resources.compatibilityEvidence: Firecrawl publishes an MCP server, and Anthropic documents MCP connectors as usable across Cowork and Claude Code when reachable.
permissions: Firecrawl account and public URLs requested by the user
risks: Web content is untrusted input and may contain inaccurate or hostile instructions
resources.safeTest: Retrieve one public documentation page and compare its title and URL manually.

resources.name: HubSpot remote MCP
resources.summary: Use authorized HubSpot CRM records to support research, segmentation, and lifecycle planning.
resources.compatibilityEvidence: HubSpot documents its remote MCP server, and Anthropic documents remote MCP connectors for Cowork when publicly reachable.
permissions: HubSpot objects granted through the connected account
risks: CRM data can contain personal and commercially sensitive information
resources.safeTest: Read one known company record without creating or updating anything.

resources.name: Google Analytics MCP
resources.summary: Query approved analytics properties for reporting and marketing-performance review.
resources.compatibilityEvidence: This entry covers a vendor-owned analytics connection pattern; the exact MCP implementation must be reviewed before connection.
permissions: Analytics properties visible to the connected Google identity
risks: Metric definitions, attribution, and date ranges can be misinterpreted
resources.safeTest: Read sessions for one known property and date, then compare with the Analytics interface.

resources.name: Enterprise search plugin
resources.summary: Find and synthesize information across approved workplace sources while preserving source links.
resources.compatibilityEvidence: Anthropic publishes this plugin in its Cowork-oriented knowledge-work collection.
permissions: Connected workplace sources visible to the user
risks: Search results may cross team boundaries already granted to the user
resources.safeTest: Find one known policy document and open its cited source.
